source: Direct app UI candidates; two independent visual reviews; only unanimous fit/wrong labels retained as 1/0. All 60 observations retained, including uncertain/disagreement with label null.

labelSemantics.1: both reviewers said the image clearly fits the exact visible definition
labelSemantics.0: both reviewers said the image clearly does not fit the exact visible definition
labelSemantics.null: uncertain or reviewer disagreement; excluded from binary evaluation/training

galleries.definition: Of an animal, to move swiftly on foot by taking quick steps, as a fox does.
Of an animal, to remain upright on its feet without moving, as a fox standing in a field.
To hold an object while transporting it from one place to another.
Next to or at the side of something.
To cause liquid to flow in a stream from a container or into one.
To consume a liquid through the mouth.
A door is open when it is not shut and a passage through it is unobstructed.
A door is closed when it fully covers its opening, leaving no passage through it.
